title: The final win epilogue says 'The reeve of Last Light never got his watch shield back, nor a word of why, and never spoke your name again' -- this contradicts the reeve's own warm, grateful dialogue earlier in the run, and is also factually backwards: the watch shield was a gift he pressed on me ('Take the shield -- it has stopped worse than claws'), never something borrowed or owed back. This is the same Barrow Doors bug (see above) surfacing all the way in the ending text.
